notes.zh-CN: 修复 Codex 重启后 6.2 模型消失的问题：使用独立安装的 Codex 运行时，按项目和账号恢复模型目录并自动重试刷新；已打开会话的旧列表不再遮住刷新发现的新模型。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备。
notes.en: Fix Codex 6.2 models disappearing after app restarts. Use the separately installed Codex runtime, restore model catalogs per project and account, and retry discovery automatically. Older options in an open session no longer hide models discovered by refresh. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
